scope: Exploratory filtering of existing non-overlapping EMA and Kotlin research episodes. No new signals or scheduling changes. Not independent confirmation.
selection: Eligible only if mean net at 40bps positive and precision >= base+5pp, coverage>=10%, resolved>=50. Select greatest mean net at 40bps; name breaks ties. Otherwise abstain.
report: All candidates and discarded cases, Wilson95, month block bootstrap paired gross-minus40bps accepted vs rejected-zero scenarios. Descriptive intervals do not adjust multiple selection.
